_README: Bubblewrap configuration for a Trusted Web Activity. This is a TEMPLATE, not a working file: the two fields marked REPLACE cannot come from this repository. Run `bubblewrap init --manifest <live manifest url>` and compare its output against this; everything here except those two fields is derived from manifest.json, which is the single source of truth for the app's name, colours and icons.
_host: REPLACE if you use a custom domain. With a GitHub Pages project site this is the github.io host and startUrl carries the path.
name: EDMGLAB — Energy Devices & Materials Group
_packageId: REPLACE with your own reverse-domain identifier. It is permanent: Play treats a changed package id as a different app, and every installed copy of the old one is orphaned.
_icons: Absolute URLs, so Bubblewrap fetches the same files the site serves. The maskable icon has verified safe-zone padding: its content sits 161 px from centre against a 205 px safe radius, so a circular Android mask does not clip it.
_shortcuts: Long-press the launcher icon. These mirror manifest.json's shortcuts; keep them in step or drop them here and let Bubblewrap read them from the manifest.
_signingKey: NEVER put a keystore or its passwords in this repository. Bubblewrap prompts for them and stores them outside the project.
_fallbackType: What happens on a device without a Chrome new enough for TWA: 'customtabs' opens the site in a Custom Tab, which still works and still runs offline. The alternative, 'webview', has a different and older JavaScript engine and is not worth the risk here.
